info.title: Spanish-speaking demand vs Spanish-speaking lawyer supply, by state and metro: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Spanish-speaking demand vs Spanish-speaking lawyer supply, by state and metro: How many people who speak Spanish at home, and how many who speak English less than very well, there are for each lawyer who speaks Spanish at home: for the US, every state and DC, and every metro area. Computed from the Census Bureau's American Community Survey (2020 to 2024 five-year tables and microdata), each figure with its 90% margin of error and a reliability flag; estimates too unreliable to publish are withheld. Aggregates only: no lawyer or firm is listed or ranked.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
